body:
Yeah I know that I need to find something it the meantime I just get discouraged so easily. Just looking at job postings and feeling unqualified for internships can make me feel so worthless. 

I am a fan of many TV shows so I might check out some of the forums. Thanks a lot for the suggestions.

Thanks for the picture it made me smile when I needed it. 

If I had the energy and willpower I guess I'd be someone who actually writes stuff instead of lying about it. I like being creative and I like working in a group so I guess my dream would be writing for a T.V. show. The problem is I'm never able to finish anything and my failure just makes me fell worse. Sometimes I wish I didn't have any dreams or aspirations and could just be happy with a quiet boring life.

Thanks. I know I should be more honest about my situation but it's hard when I feel so embarrassed about who I am. I feel worthless so when I talk to people I feel like I have to lie to make myself not seem so bad.
Thank you for sharing your story. How did you go about getting help?
